description: Feedspace helps users manage customer reviews and testimonials from ChatGPT. Users can list, filter, inspect, import, and edit reviews; manage labels; create and style review collection forms; build Wall of Love pages and embeddable widgets; invite teammates; and configure auto-add rules for new reviews.
